# Deploris

> Tailored, efficient, reliable IT solutions. Deploris delivers hardware and infrastructure services alongside custom CRM, RAG systems, AI agents, and bespoke software for businesses in the US and Germany.

Deploris is a technology services company with two coordinated service lines under one team:

## Hardware & Infrastructure
- Infrastructure support & maintenance
- Network support
- Rollout & migrations
- Desktop support (remote / on-site)
- IMAC & projects
- Hardware break-fix / maintenance
- WiFi surveys
- Data-center maintenance & support

## Software Development
- Custom CRM development
- RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) systems
- AI agents & workflow automation
- Custom systems & integrations

## How to reach Deploris
- Website: https://deploris.com
- Email: hello@deploris.com
- Phone: +1 (321) 495-3200
- Languages: English (US), German (Sie)
- Regions: United States and Germany. EU-region processing available for German B2B clients.
